items.t: Approve meeting minutes of July 7, 2026 and July 27, 2026

Adopt Ordinance No. 2308 approving (1) initiation of proceedings for annexation (P25-0115), (2) General Plan amendments (P25-0116), (3) rezoning (P25-0118), (4) a Planned Unit Development (PUD-154) plan for residential development with related on- and off-site infrastructure, and (5) a Vesting Tentative Subdivision Map (Tract 8423) associated with the Arroyo Lago residential project

Adopt Ordinance No. 2309 approving the Pre-Annexation and Development Agreement between the City of Pleasanton and 330 Land Company, LLC for the development of the Arroyo Lago residential project filed under Case Nos. P25-0115, P25-0116, P25-0118, PUD-154, and Tract 8423
